verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Sierra detecting knowledge gaps or flagging conflicting content. Related features exist: Studio lets you view and edit the knowledge that grounds the agent, Insights shows which knowledge sources sat behind each answer, and Explorer analyzes conversations and sends weekly briefings on emerging issues. These are diagnostic tools a user could apply by hand, so they count as adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions
